# BiggerPockets

> > BiggerPockets is the largest online community and resource hub for real estate investors, featuring forums, educational content, books by authors like Brandon Turner and David Greene, and tools for landlords and property investors.

BiggerPockets provides comprehensive resources for real estate investing education, including specialized content on strategies like BRRRR (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat), tax optimization courses by experts like Amanda Han and Matt MacFarland, and practical tools such as state-specific lease agreements and The Intention Journal for goal-setting investors.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Investing
- BRRRR Strategy
- Brandon Turner
- David Greene
- J Scott
- BPCON (BiggerPockets Conference)
